The conjugation roadmap

Verbs · the roadmap · a dummy page

every form right in rehearsallesson donestill aheadright in rehearsalwrong in rehearsalnot in circulation

Every tense of every shape, in one place. A green frame round a tense: every form right in rehearsal. An orange frame: the lesson is done. No frame: still ahead. Inside, a form in green was right in rehearsal, one in red wrong, and a plain one is not in circulation yet. The groups run from the fully regular families, through the spelling changes, the verbs irregular only in the participle and the irregular shapes, to the fully irregular verbs.
